set.body:
Outcome

Create one inseparable scientific binding from compiled ordinal schedule to semantic sample universe.

Acceptance

- Constructor accepts the owning Compiled value, exact SampleAxis, population fingerprint, labels, and seed authority.
- Plan and receipt cannot diverge.
- Selection, injection, draw, and permutation retain order and multiplicity.
- Every ordinal can be mapped back to the authoritative SampleId.
set.title: P3.2: bind Resample4s Compiled schedules to exact SampleAxis identity
